controlled_change_from_failed_19e.unchanged: allocation.dt=86400 s, topology, source, demands, priorities, min_level physics, independent references and tolerances

qualified_claims: When solver.saveat and allocation.dt are both 86400 s, the initial one-day priority allocation remains the physical target for the one-day horizon in the tested pinned Ribasim configuration.
Root-first remains 32/0 m3/day and external-first remains 12/20 m3/day.
Common min_level physics reduces already allocated paths without same-window management reallocation.
Allocated-but-unrealized volume remains in Basin storage over the clock-aligned window.
Priority changes recipient split but not total physical supply or Basin endpoint when total allocation and physical reduction are common.
boundaries: This qualifies the clock-aligned configuration only.
It does not rehabilitate failed DUMMY-19E with hourly saveat.
It does not establish that saveat should own the management clock.
